Needs changes before merge.

The parameter edit, undo, project file, MCP tool, and generator use the same rest group. Invalid values are refused by name. Rest machining is off by default.

Local results: the trial merge with upstream/main at a330f7cbdf80797feb3330831a2587fc6c40d74e was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app unit tests | 314 passed; 1 ignored |
| app golden_cl | 33 passed |
| app predrilled_entry | 8 passed |
| app project_roundtrip | 73 passed |
| app rest_pocket | 6 passed |
| app tool_gate | 9 passed |
| motion unit tests | 366 passed; 5 ignored |
| motion machining2d | 66 passed |
| motion predrilled_entry | 6 passed |
| motion rest2d | 10 passed |
| UI unit tests, from crates/ui | 813 passed; 6 ignored |
| UI edge_loop_pick | 3 passed |
| UI operations | 31 passed |
| clippy, motion/app/UI, all targets, -D warnings | Passed |

This is a safety review. I read all 128 lines of the new pocket_rest_corners.cl golden. No existing golden changes. The new path has four corner rings at each of three heights, with retract moves between corners. The stock test checks the two levels below the top face.

I ran two mutation checks locally:

- Remove the rest_gate call from EditOperationParams: the tool-size refusal test failed with `expected a refusal`.
- Remove the positive previous-tool-diameter check: bad_rest_parameters_are_refused_by_name failed because the required refusal text was absent.

Both files were restored byte for byte. All six app rest_pocket tests and the motion refusal test then passed again.

Requested before merge:

1. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:142`: this edit changes a process file. Add the exact line `Process change: yes` to the PR body, as required by the process rules. Do not change PROCESS_VERSION in this PR.

Notes: the UI code only preserves the rest field. It adds no visible control, so before/after UI images do not apply to this diff. The dialog is tracked in #1815. The extra air cuts and entry limits are stated in the body and tracked separately. The gate dry run selects most of the workspace; this review ran the selected suites above, not the full workspace gate. Pixel snapshot tests were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the latest review's only requested change. The PR body now includes the exact line `Process change: yes`. PROCESS_VERSION and all source files are unchanged.

Verified the exact line by reading the PR body back. A code pin and mutation check do not apply to this metadata-only fix.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (motion, app, UI; zero failures). Clippy passed for camcraft-motion, camcraft-app, and camcraft-ui, all targets, with `-D warnings`.

Head remains `f4c9f1ea6642a8122cc8b7022ad08ca6aeb400a8`. Plain push reported everything up to date. The PR remains a draft.

Please re-review.
